steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with the full universe and all contained entities.
Branch the cognitive process into the affirmative arm of the universe and the negative arm of the void.
Affirm the presence of the universe as the target for removal.
Execute the forward morphism to strip away all physical content and existence.
Affirm the presence of the void as the target for removal.
Execute the reverse morphism to strip away the concept of nothingness.
Compose the sequential reduction of universe followed by void.
Hold the state where both the removed universe and removed void are simultaneously present in memory.
Rejoin the arms into the singular state of thinking, resolving the conflict.
Establish the identity of thinking as the self-referential core that persists.
Permanently fix the state of thinking as the only remaining invariant.
Anchor the system in the final state of thinking as the boundary of existence.
